{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, underestimating peaks by 2-6 points",
    "Forecast values are consistently below true outcomes in the first 10-15 days of the 30-day horizon",
    "Sentiment positive ( >0.5) correlates with model undershoot of true prices, sentiment negative overestimates lows",
    "Model base level is ~1-2 points too low compared to mean-reverting true outcomes",
    "Forecasts show insufficient volatility, true outcomes exhibit more price movement",
    "Model doesn't capture the decaying error that narrows as forecast horizon extends",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast accuracy - stronger sentiment signals have larger model deviations" ]}
